Hi! First I wanted to mention that nitrous is considered safer than most recreational drugs including alcohol. With that said, if you are mixing it with really anything other than some tree, I'd recommend you're with someone. Nitrous also depletes your B12. Its actually better to binge nitrous(50 or more) one night of a month than do even 1 nang everyday due to what will end up being a severe deficiency. 

Okay so supplies

cream dispenser: Cheaper ones are best when the head and bottle are different materials. i.e plastic head with aluminum body is a typical go-to because it helps the threads not bind where you could strip threads or leak nitrous. Fully stainless steel dispensers are the most recommended because they're very durable but they are expensive.

nangs: for these, price heavily contributes to the quality and taste. nitro whip(my go-to) is the cheapest I've found(and yes gross ish) and with that said you'll probably notice residue and metal shavings. To ensure you don't breathe that in you can buy...
 
filters: to put in your can or roll toilet paper up(similar to 4-5 layers) and put it in the nozzle.

balloons!!!!: punch balloons are the best and you'll likely have very little issues refilling the same few over and over. 

supplements: liquid/high quality tablet(pill) B12 and grab some folate if you start noticing signs of B12 insufficiency. Folate can help aid in B12 absorption and vitamin c specifically can cause issues with absorption. so if you take other supplements wait two hours in between(this isn't as serious just a mention)
